speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Of course, there are a lot of people who can speak foreign languages in China.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: But from my perspective, in my social circle, I don't actually know a person who can speak two languages fluently.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: From the internet, though, I know a lot of people who speak many languages — English, of course, Mandarin and Cantonese, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, and so on.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: And China is a huge country with a huge population.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: If you just mean "speak," then yes — even I can say a few Japanese words, like Konnichiwa.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Because we have this compulsory education system where every student learns English at school, so everybody can speak some English — maybe not fluently, but they can speak.
